tables.name: 04_LEVELS
tables.description: The H01–H17 sequence is a research navigation spine, not one official universal taxonomy.

records.Scientific Definition: A nonmaterial control layer for mathematics, ontology, quantities, units, uncertainty and evidence.
records.Classification Criteria: Axioms, invariants, relation semantics and dimensional consistency
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Relativistic quantum fields described by field content, operators, symmetries, couplings, vacuum state and Lagrangian dynamics.
records.Classification Criteria: Lorentz and gauge representations; Standard Model gauge group SU(3)C × SU(2)L × U(1)Y where applicable
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Quarks, leptons, gauge bosons and the Higgs boson with no established internal substructure.
records.Classification Criteria: Poincaré representation, mass, spin/helicity, charges, flavor, interactions and experimental compositeness bounds
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Color-singlet hadrons and related composite quantum states produced by nonperturbative QCD dynamics.
records.Classification Criteria: Constituent content, total quantum numbers, binding/resonance spectrum and decay modes
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Nuclei and nuclear species classified by proton number, neutron number and nuclear energy state.
records.Classification Criteria: Z, N, A, J^P, binding, charge distribution, stability and decay
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Neutral atoms and the chemical-element kinds defined by proton number Z.
records.Classification Criteria: Atomic number, electron configuration, spectra and periodic properties; element and atom remain distinct categories
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Charged monatomic or polyatomic chemical entities and their charge-state-dependent behavior.
records.Classification Criteria: Chemical identity, electron count, net charge, solvation/coordination and transport context
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Discrete molecular entities, macromolecules, coordination entities and supramolecular assemblies.
records.Classification Criteria: Composition, connectivity, stereochemistry, geometry, charge and molecular state
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Official Scientific Name: Crystal lattices, unit cells, phases and materials
records.Scientific Definition: Periodic and aperiodic crystals, phases, microstructures, defects and amorphous materials.
records.Classification Criteria: Discrete diffraction/order, lattice plus basis where periodic, space group, atomic positions, defects, phase and microstructure
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Natural mineral species and specimens governed chiefly by composition, crystallographic properties and accepted nomenclature.
records.Classification Criteria: IMA species criteria, chemical composition, structure, natural occurrence and diagnostic properties
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Rocks, sediments, regolith and soils classified by composition, texture, structure, origin and state.
records.Classification Criteria: Genetic family, modal composition, bulk chemistry, fabric, porosity, strength and material history
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Faults, folds and other macroscopic deformation structures in rock and sediment.
records.Classification Criteria: Geometry, orientation, displacement, strain, stress and kinematic history
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Beds, members, formations, groups and supergroups recognized by lithic properties and stratigraphic relations.
records.Classification Criteria: Mappability, lithology, boundary definition, rank and stratigraphic position
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Regions of subsidence/accommodation containing preserved sedimentary fill and associated thermal, structural and fluid history.
records.Classification Criteria: Subsidence mechanism/rate, basin geometry, sediment volume, heat flow, fill and boundaries
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Sedimentary basins with regionally significant evaporite deposition and possible later salt tectonics/dissolution; a scientific descriptive subclass, not a separate universal rank.
records.Classification Criteria: Water/brine balance, restriction, evaporite stratigraphy, salt rheology, burial and tectonic evolution
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Regional tectonic provinces, depositional systems, aquifers, groundwater systems, river systems and drainage basins.
records.Classification Criteria: Spatial boundaries, structure, stores, fluxes, connectivity, forcing, rheology, thermal state and history
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: The biological branch from cells and organisms through populations, communities, ecosystems, landscapes and biomes.
records.Classification Criteria: Living organization, membership, interactions, spatial boundary, productivity, nutrient cycling and dynamics
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

records.Scientific Definition: Earth’s atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere, geosphere and biosphere as a coupled planetary system.
records.Classification Criteria: Global reservoirs, fluxes, feedbacks, forcing, state, uncertainty and planetary history
records.Ontology Status: navigational spine; not a universal official ladder

tables.name: 05_CLASSIFICATIONS
tables.description: Every classification or variant family is defined once. Placement, properties, objects and evidence are linked in junction sheets.

records.Scientific Definition: A field appearing in quantum field theory whose quantized excitations are particles; characterized by transformation properties, dynamics and couplings.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies fundamental dynamical degrees of freedom
records.Classification Criteria: Field species, Lorentz/gauge representation, Lagrangian terms
records.Evidence Status: Established theoretical framework with extensive experimental confirmation

records.Scientific Definition: The four-dimensional differentiable manifold with metric structure used to represent events, intervals and gravitation in relativity.
records.Classification Purpose: Locates physical events and encodes gravitational geometry
records.Classification Criteria: Dimension, topology, metric, curvature, causal structure
records.Evidence Status: Established theory; ontology interpretation remains model-dependent

records.Scientific Definition: A particle with no experimentally established internal structure, represented by an irreducible particle state/field excitation in the Standard Model.
records.Classification Purpose: Separates fundamental particle species from composites
records.Classification Criteria: Mass, spin, charges, quantum numbers, interactions; experimental compositeness limits
records.Evidence Status: Experimentally established classes within the Standard Model

records.Scientific Definition: A particle with half-integer spin obeying Fermi–Dirac statistics and the Pauli exclusion principle.
records.Classification Criteria: Half-integer spin; anticommutation relations

records.Scientific Definition: An elementary spin-1/2 fermion carrying color charge and fractional electric charge, occurring in six flavors.
records.Classification Criteria: Flavor, color representation, charge, mass, generation
records.Evidence Status: Experimentally established indirectly through hadronic phenomena and scattering

records.Scientific Definition: An elementary spin-1/2 fermion that is a color singlet; charged leptons and neutrinos occur in three generations.
records.Classification Criteria: Flavor, charge, mass, generation, weak quantum numbers

records.Scientific Definition: A particle with integer spin obeying Bose–Einstein statistics.
records.Classification Criteria: Integer spin and commutation relations

records.Scientific Definition: An elementary boson associated with gauge interactions: photon, gluons, and W/Z bosons in the Standard Model.
records.Classification Criteria: Gauge representation, spin, mass, charges, coupling

records.Scientific Definition: The spin-0 excitation of the Higgs field associated with electroweak symmetry breaking.
records.Classification Criteria: Spin-parity, mass, couplings and decay channels
records.Evidence Status: Experimentally established; interpretation within Standard Model

records.Scientific Definition: A particle-like bound state or resonance with experimentally established internal constituents or structure.
records.Classification Criteria: Constituent content, binding/resonance, total quantum numbers

records.Scientific Definition: A color-neutral composite state governed by the strong interaction and made from quarks, antiquarks and gluonic fields.
records.Classification Criteria: Baryon/meson class, flavor content, spin-parity, mass, lifetime

records.Scientific Definition: A hadron with half-integer spin in the ordinary three-valence-quark sector; includes nucleons.
records.Classification Criteria: Baryon number, valence content, spin-parity

records.Scientific Definition: A hadron with integer spin in the ordinary quark–antiquark sector.
records.Classification Criteria: Flavor content, spin-parity, mass, decay modes

records.Scientific Definition: A proton or neutron; a baryon that is a principal constituent of ordinary atomic nuclei.
records.Classification Criteria: Proton/neutron identity, charge, isospin, mass, magnetic moment

records.Scientific Definition: The positively charged central bound system of an atom, composed of protons and neutrons except for protium, whose nucleus is one proton.
records.Classification Purpose: Defines nuclear identity and atomic number
records.Classification Criteria: Z, N, A, nuclear energy state, spin-parity, binding and stability

records.Scientific Definition: A species of atom or nucleus specified by proton number Z, neutron number N, and nuclear energy state when necessary.
records.Classification Criteria: Z, N and energy state

records.Scientific Definition: The smallest neutral entity retaining the chemical identity of an element, consisting of a nucleus and bound electrons.
records.Classification Criteria: Atomic number, electron count/configuration, state

records.Scientific Definition: A species of atoms whose nuclei all have the same number of protons; atomic number determines element identity.
records.Classification Criteria: Atomic number Z; element name and symbol

records.Scientific Definition: An atom or molecular entity having a net electric charge due to loss or gain of electrons or other specified charging process.
records.Classification Criteria: Net charge and chemical identity

records.Scientific Definition: A charged entity formed from a single atom.
records.Classification Criteria: One atomic center and nonzero net charge

records.Scientific Definition: An electrically neutral entity consisting of more than one atom, or a molecular entity with a single atom only where explicitly permitted by nomenclature; normally defined by a distinguishable bound arrangement of atomic nuclei and electrons.
records.Classification Criteria: Atomic composition, connectivity, charge=0, molecular structure/state
records.Evidence Status: Internationally established; exact wording varies by context

records.Scientific Definition: A charged molecular entity composed of more than one atom.
records.Classification Criteria: Multiple atomic centers and nonzero net charge

records.Scientific Definition: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, complex, conformer or similar chemically identifiable entity considered individually.
records.Classification Purpose: Provides the individual-entity level for chemical description
records.Classification Criteria: Constitution, isotopic composition, charge, electronic state, conformation as relevant

records.Scientific Definition: An ensemble of chemically identical molecular entities that can explore the same set of molecular energy levels on the experimental timescale.
records.Classification Criteria: Identity and timescale-dependent indistinguishability

records.Scientific Definition: Matter of constant composition characterized by the entities of which it is composed and by physical properties under stated conditions.
records.Classification Purpose: Separates substances from mixtures and specimens
records.Classification Criteria: Composition, identity, purity and conditions

records.Scientific Definition: A chemical substance composed of atoms of two or more chemical elements in fixed stoichiometric relation, subject to accepted nonstoichiometry conventions.
records.Classification Criteria: Elemental composition, stoichiometry, structure

records.Scientific Definition: A material containing two or more substances not chemically combined in a fixed stoichiometric identity; may be homogeneous or heterogeneous.
records.Classification Criteria: Components, composition fractions, phase distribution

records.Scientific Definition: A region of a material system that is uniform in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other regions by boundaries.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies homogeneous portions and states of systems
records.Classification Criteria: Intensive state variables, composition, symmetry/order parameter

records.Scientific Definition: A finite aggregate of a countable number of atoms or molecules whose properties differ from isolated constituents and often from bulk matter.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies finite aggregates between molecular and bulk regimes
records.Classification Criteria: Constituent count, composition, geometry, charge and binding
records.Evidence Status: Established research class; boundaries can be conventional

records.Scientific Definition: A molecule of high relative molecular mass whose structure comprises repeated or complex subunits and whose properties depend on that high molecular mass.
records.Classification Criteria: Molar mass, repeat/sequence structure, architecture

records.Scientific Definition: A macromolecule containing multiple constitutional repeating units or derived from polymerization.
records.Classification Criteria: Repeat units, degree of polymerization, architecture

records.Scientific Definition: An organized association of two or more molecular entities maintained principally by noncovalent interactions and/or topological association.
records.Classification Criteria: Component identity, stoichiometry, interaction topology, cooperativity

records.Scientific Definition: A particle with external dimensions in the nanoscale, commonly about 1–100 nm, whose properties may be size- and surface-dependent.
records.Classification Criteria: External dimensions, morphology, composition, surface state

records.Scientific Definition: Matter selected or designed for use or study, characterized by composition, structure, processing, properties and performance.
records.Classification Criteria: Composition, phase, microstructure, form and function

records.Scientific Definition: A material possessing crystalline order in all or part of its volume.
records.Classification Criteria: Diffraction, long-range order, crystal fraction

records.Scientific Definition: A solid having an essentially discrete diffraction pattern; may be periodic or aperiodic.
records.Classification Criteria: Discrete diffraction, order and symmetry

records.Scientific Definition: A crystal whose structure has three-dimensional translational periodicity.
records.Classification Criteria: Translation lattice, unit cell, space group

records.Scientific Definition: A crystal with long-range order and discrete diffraction but without three-dimensional lattice periodicity.
records.Classification Criteria: Diffraction module/superspace description; absence of 3D lattice periodicity

records.Scientific Definition: An aperiodic crystal with quasiperiodic order, often showing symmetries incompatible with periodic lattices.
records.Classification Criteria: Discrete diffraction indexable in higher-rank modules; quasiperiodicity

records.Scientific Definition: A solid lacking the long-range translational or quasiperiodic order characteristic of crystals, though short-range order may be present.
records.Classification Criteria: Diffuse diffraction, glass transition behavior, local structure
records.Evidence Status: Established; glass definition can be operational

records.Scientific Definition: A solid aggregate of many crystal grains separated by grain boundaries.
records.Classification Criteria: Grain population, orientations, boundaries and texture

records.Scientific Definition: The arrangement, size, morphology, distribution and interfaces of phases, grains, pores and defects at microscopic to mesoscopic scales.
records.Classification Criteria: Feature types, length scales, topology and statistics

records.Scientific Definition: A contiguous crystalline region with a substantially uniform crystallographic orientation.
records.Classification Criteria: Orientation coherence and grain boundary

records.Scientific Definition: A departure from the ideal reference crystal structure, including point, line, planar and volume defects.
records.Classification Criteria: Dimensionality, topology, chemistry and displacement field

records.Scientific Definition: A naturally occurring solid substance recognized chiefly by characteristic chemical composition and crystallographic properties under IMA rules.
records.Classification Purpose: Governs mineral names and species identity
records.Classification Criteria: Chemical composition, crystal structure, natural occurrence and nomenclature rules

records.Scientific Definition: A particular natural occurrence of matter instantiating one or more mineral species, commonly with impurities, defects, zoning or intergrowths.
records.Classification Purpose: Separates individual object from mineral species name
records.Classification Criteria: Species identity, locality, texture, composition and structure

records.Scientific Definition: A naturally occurring mineral-like substance that does not meet all mineral-species criteria, commonly because it lacks crystalline order or has poorly defined composition.
records.Classification Purpose: Keeps noncrystalline natural substances distinct from minerals
records.Classification Criteria: Natural occurrence, material properties, failure of mineral criteria

records.Scientific Definition: A naturally occurring consolidated or coherent aggregate of one or more minerals, mineraloids, glass or organic material, classified principally by origin, composition and texture.
records.Classification Criteria: Genesis, modal composition, texture, structure and chemistry
records.Evidence Status: Established; schemes depend on rock family

records.Scientific Definition: Rock formed by solidification or crystallization of magma or lava.
records.Classification Criteria: Mode of occurrence, texture, modal mineralogy or chemistry

records.Scientific Definition: Rock formed by deposition and lithification of sediment or by chemical/biogenic precipitation at or near Earth’s surface.
records.Classification Criteria: Depositional origin, grain size, composition, texture and structures

records.Scientific Definition: Rock transformed in the solid state by changes in temperature, pressure, stress and fluid activity, producing new mineral assemblages and fabrics.
records.Classification Criteria: Protolith, mineral assemblage, texture/fabric and pressure–temperature history

records.Scientific Definition: Unconsolidated particles or chemical/biological precipitates transported or deposited by water, wind, ice, gravity or in situ processes.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies mobile and deposited particulate material
records.Classification Criteria: Grain size, composition, sorting, shape, fabric and depositional setting

records.Scientific Definition: The layer of loose, heterogeneous material overlying coherent bedrock, including weathered rock, soil and transported deposits.
records.Classification Criteria: Position above bedrock, origin, degree of weathering and material type

records.Scientific Definition: A natural body at the land surface consisting of mineral and organic matter, water, air and organisms, organized into horizons by soil-forming processes.
records.Classification Criteria: Horizons, morphology, composition, climate/organism/relief/parent material/time effects

records.Scientific Definition: A body of rock defined and recognized on the basis of observable lithic properties and stratigraphic relations.
records.Classification Purpose: Maps rock bodies independently of age
records.Classification Criteria: Lithology, boundaries, stratigraphic position and mappability

records.Scientific Definition: The smallest formal lithostratigraphic unit, a distinctive layer within a member or formation.
records.Classification Criteria: Distinct lithic layer and traceability

records.Scientific Definition: A formal lithostratigraphic unit below formation rank, used for a lithologically distinctive part of a formation.
records.Classification Criteria: Distinctive lithology and stratigraphic position

records.Scientific Definition: The fundamental formal lithostratigraphic unit: a mappable body of rock identified by lithic characteristics and stratigraphic position.
records.Classification Criteria: Mappability at chosen scale, lithic distinction, defined boundaries and type section

records.Scientific Definition: A formal lithostratigraphic unit comprising two or more associated formations or equivalent units.
records.Classification Criteria: Regional stratigraphic association

records.Scientific Definition: A formal assemblage of related groups or formations used for very large stratigraphic packages.
records.Classification Criteria: Regional association of groups/formations

records.Scientific Definition: A geometric arrangement or deformation feature in rock or sediment produced by geologic processes.
records.Classification Criteria: Geometry, kinematics, orientation, scale and cross-cutting relations

records.Scientific Definition: A fracture or zone of fractures across which there has been measurable displacement.
records.Classification Criteria: Slip, orientation, kinematics, geometry and timing

records.Scientific Definition: A curved or bent geologic surface or layered body produced by deformation.
records.Classification Criteria: Axial surface, hinge, wavelength, amplitude, orientation and vergence

records.Scientific Definition: A region of prolonged subsidence or accommodation in which sediments accumulate and are preserved as a basin fill.
records.Classification Purpose: Integrates subsidence, sediment supply, stratigraphy and thermal history
records.Classification Criteria: Basin geometry, subsidence mechanism/history, fill, boundaries and tectonic setting

records.Scientific Definition: A sedimentary/depositional basin containing regionally significant evaporite deposition and commonly later dissolution or salt deformation; ‘salt basin’ is descriptive rather than a universal formal rank.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies basin systems dominated in part by evaporite accumulation/evolution
records.Classification Criteria: Evaporite volume/stratigraphy, brine restriction and concentration, basin setting, salt tectonics where present

records.Scientific Definition: A three-dimensional assemblage of genetically linked depositional environments and processes through which sediment is transported and deposited.
records.Classification Criteria: Process linkage, facies, sediment routing, environment and boundaries

records.Scientific Definition: A connected set of sediment sources, transport pathways, depositional sinks and recycling processes operating over defined space and time.
records.Classification Criteria: Source, flux, connectivity, storage, sink, grain-size and timescale

records.Scientific Definition: A geologic formation, group of formations, or part of a formation that is sufficiently permeable to transmit useful quantities of groundwater.
records.Classification Criteria: Hydraulic conductivity, saturated thickness, storage, connectivity and boundaries

records.Scientific Definition: A hydraulically connected set of aquifers and confining units functioning as a regional groundwater system.
records.Classification Criteria: Hydraulic connectivity, heads, recharge/discharge, aquifers and confining units

records.Scientific Definition: A groundwater domain defined by recharge areas, flow paths, storage, discharge areas and hydraulic boundary conditions.
records.Classification Criteria: Hydraulic head field, flow paths, boundaries, stores and fluxes

records.Scientific Definition: Flowing surface water within a natural channel, considered as water body, channel and process under specified scope.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies fluvial flow and channel bodies
records.Classification Criteria: Channel geometry, discharge regime, sediment transport, network position

records.Scientific Definition: A connected network of channels, tributaries, floodplains and associated water/sediment fluxes draining toward an outlet.
records.Classification Criteria: Connectivity, drainage topology, discharge, sediment flux and outlet

records.Scientific Definition: The land area and associated surface and subsurface waters that drain to a specified outlet; terminology varies by jurisdiction.
records.Classification Purpose: Defines control volume for water and material budgets
records.Classification Criteria: Topographic or hydrologic divide, outlet, contributing area and nested scale

records.Scientific Definition: A bounded set of water stores, fluxes, phase changes and interactions across atmosphere, surface, subsurface and biota.
records.Classification Criteria: Boundary, reservoirs, fluxes, forcing, state variables and timescale

records.Scientific Definition: A spatially heterogeneous area composed of interacting ecosystems, landforms and land-cover patches at a scale relevant to the process studied.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies spatial mosaics and cross-boundary flows
records.Classification Criteria: Patch mosaic, connectivity, relief, land cover, process scale

records.Scientific Definition: A region distinguished by coherent geologic history, structure, stratigraphy or tectonic character.
records.Classification Criteria: Boundary rationale, structural/stratigraphic coherence, tectonic history

records.Scientific Definition: A lithospheric plate and its boundaries/interactions, described within plate tectonics.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies large-scale lithospheric motion and deformation
records.Classification Criteria: Plate boundary, velocity, rigidity approximation, interaction type
records.Evidence Status: Established theory/model with observed plate motions

records.Scientific Definition: A molecule produced by or functioning in living systems, including nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, carbohydrates and metabolites.
records.Classification Criteria: Structure, biosynthetic/functional context, sequence or composition

records.Scientific Definition: A specialized subcellular structure with defined molecular composition and function, commonly membrane-bound in eukaryotes but not universally so.
records.Classification Criteria: Boundary/structure, molecular composition and cellular function

records.Scientific Definition: The basic membrane-bounded unit of life capable of regulated metabolism and biological information processing; cells may be organisms or parts of multicellular organisms.
records.Classification Criteria: Membrane boundary, metabolism, genetic system, reproduction/maintenance capacity

records.Scientific Definition: An organized ensemble of cells and extracellular material performing related functions in a multicellular organism.
records.Classification Criteria: Cell types, extracellular matrix, organization and function

records.Scientific Definition: A discrete body part composed of multiple tissues organized to perform one or more functions.
records.Classification Criteria: Tissue organization, boundary and function

records.Scientific Definition: A functionally integrated set of organs and associated tissues within an organism.
records.Classification Criteria: Participating organs, connections, regulation and function

records.Scientific Definition: An individual living system with integrated organization, metabolism, regulation and a life cycle; individuality can be complex in colonial and modular life.
records.Classification Purpose: Unit for physiology, life history and population membership
records.Classification Criteria: Biological individuality, integration, lineage/life cycle

records.Scientific Definition: Individuals of the same species occupying a defined area and time with potential demographic and genetic interaction.
records.Classification Criteria: Species identity, spatial/temporal boundary, demographic connection

records.Scientific Definition: Populations of different species occurring and interacting in a defined place and time.
records.Classification Criteria: Species composition, interactions, spatial/temporal boundary

records.Scientific Definition: A community of organisms together with the nonliving physical and chemical environment interacting through energy flow and material cycling in a defined area.
records.Classification Criteria: Boundary, community, abiotic environment, fluxes and processes

records.Scientific Definition: A large regional ecological unit characterized by climate, dominant vegetation or other broad biotic structure; marine biome schemes use different criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: Climate, vegetation/functional form, geography and disturbance regime

records.Scientific Definition: The global sum of living organisms and the regions of Earth where life interacts with atmosphere, hydrosphere and geosphere.
records.Classification Criteria: Extent of life, biomass, productivity and biogeochemical coupling

records.Scientific Definition: The gaseous envelope surrounding Earth, stratified by composition and thermal/dynamical structure.
records.Classification Purpose: Planetary gas reservoir and circulation system
records.Classification Criteria: Composition, pressure, temperature, circulation and vertical structure

records.Scientific Definition: All water in liquid form at or near Earth’s surface and subsurface, often used more broadly for all planetary water reservoirs depending on convention.
records.Classification Criteria: Water distribution, state, salinity, storage and flux

records.Scientific Definition: Earth’s frozen-water components, including snow, glaciers, ice sheets, sea ice, permafrost and frozen ground.
records.Classification Criteria: Ice/snow extent, mass balance, temperature and dynamics

records.Scientific Definition: The solid Earth, including crust, mantle and core and their geologic materials and processes.
records.Classification Criteria: Composition, structure, rheology, heat flow and tectonic dynamics

records.Scientific Definition: Earth considered as an interacting system of atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere, geosphere and biosphere, driven by internal energy and external forcing.
records.Classification Purpose: Integrates planetary reservoirs, fluxes, feedbacks and evolution
records.Classification Criteria: Subsystem coupling, global budgets, forcing, feedback, state and history

records.Scientific Definition: A phase that sustains shear stress on relevant timescales and has a stable shape in the absence of external forcing; may be crystalline or amorphous.
records.Classification Criteria: Mechanical response, structure and phase behavior

records.Scientific Definition: A condensed fluid phase with no long-range shear rigidity at equilibrium, approximately fixed volume and ability to flow.
records.Classification Criteria: Fluidity, density, viscosity, local order and phase equilibrium

records.Scientific Definition: A compressible fluid phase that expands to fill its container and has relatively low particle density compared with condensed phases.
records.Classification Criteria: Equation of state, density, pressure, temperature and composition

records.Scientific Definition: A quasineutral ionized gas exhibiting collective electromagnetic behavior and screening over scales larger than the Debye length.
records.Classification Purpose: Distinguishes collective ionized matter from ordinary gas
records.Classification Criteria: Ionization, quasineutrality, Debye length, plasma frequency and collective response
records.Evidence Status: Established; plasma-physics depth is an expansion area

records.Scientific Definition: A fluid above its critical temperature and pressure where liquid and gas are not separated by a first-order phase boundary.
records.Classification Criteria: T>Tc and P>Pc; continuous density variation

records.Scientific Definition: One of two or more nuclides having the same atomic number Z but different neutron numbers N and therefore different mass numbers A; isotope identity is always relative to an element.
records.Classification Purpose: Classifies variants of one element by nuclear composition
records.Classification Criteria: Same Z; different N (and A); nuclear state specified separately when needed
records.Evidence Status: IUPAC-established; nuclear stability requires models and measurements

records.Scientific Definition: A metastable excited state of a nuclide with a measurable lifetime, distinguished from its ground state or other isomers.
records.Classification Criteria: Same Z and N; distinct nuclear energy state, spin-parity and lifetime

records.Scientific Definition: An assembly consisting of a central atom or ion, commonly metallic, surrounded by ligands with coordinate bonding interactions.
records.Classification Criteria: Central atom/ion, ligands, coordination number, geometry, charge and connectivity

records.Scientific Definition: An ion together with a specified solvation environment, usually represented statistically by ion–dipole, hydrogen-bonding and coordination interactions with solvent molecules.
records.Classification Purpose: Separates free-ion notation from solution-state structure
records.Classification Criteria: Ion identity, solvent, coordination/solvation number, exchange timescale and thermodynamic state

records.Scientific Definition: A crystal in which oppositely charged ions occupy an extended ordered structure stabilized substantially by Coulombic interactions, with additional short-range and polarization effects.
records.Classification Criteria: Composition, ionic sites/occupancies, space group, lattice plus basis, coordination and electrostatic stability

records.Scientific Definition: A mineral species whose essential chemical composition consists of one element, including polymorphs such as graphite and diamond for carbon.
records.Classification Purpose: Distinguishes mineral species in the native-element class from abstract chemical elements
records.Classification Criteria: Natural occurrence, single-element essential composition, crystal structure and IMA species criteria

records.Scientific Definition: Electrostatic interaction between charged chemical entities; in solids it is a collective, nonlocalized contribution to lattice binding rather than a set of isolated two-body bonds.
records.Classification Criteria: Charges, separation, dielectric environment, coordination, polarization and quantum-mechanical short-range terms

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for charged lepton.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: −e

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for neutral lepton.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for gauge boson pair.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: ±e

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for scalar boson.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for antiparticle counterpart.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: opposite additive charges/quantum numbers relative to counterpart

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for Standard Model field family.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: field degrees of freedom and representation content

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for hadron family.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: quarks, antiquarks and gluonic fields in a color-singlet state

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for nuclear classification.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: protons and neutrons; deeper QCD description applies

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for ion class.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: atomic or molecular entity with specified charge state

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for molecular entity class.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: atoms connected or associated under a defined bonding/interaction description

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for crystal system.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: periodic structure categorized through point-group action

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for Bravais lattice.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: infinite ideal translation lattice

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for crystallographic point group.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: rotations/reflections/rotoinversions fixing a point

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for plane group.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: two-dimensional isometries with translations

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for rod group.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: one-dimensional translations in three-dimensional space

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for layer group.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: two-dimensional translations in three-dimensional space

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for space-group type.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
records.Classification Criteria: three-dimensional isometries including translations

records.Scientific Definition: Classification family for Nickel–Strunz top-level class.
records.Classification Purpose: Groups scientific objects sharing the stated family criteria.
